summary: Re-review after revision: all four prior findings are resolved and verified against source. (1) Step 1.3 now presents the untouched-zone scenario as an explicit two-option tier; both new quotes were spot-checked segment-by-segment against data/transcripts/tCfmxMX5WaU.txt (transcript lines ~910-926) and are verbatim with ASR noise characters preserved and correct ordering, with the speaker's no-chase preference correctly marked as default. (2) Profile section 6.1 now lists 18 contributing videos including yZoSW3DGRGI with a role annotation, and SKILL.md line 147 matches, restoring profile/skill sync. (3) Resources now carries a path note (line 149) stating analysis/ and data/ paths are relative to the project root with the absolute path given, addressing the auto-axis portability finding. (4) evidence.md section 5 hidden-FVG/BPR quotes now carry per-quote provenance labels (transcript / note+transcript), and the two newly added BPR transcript-supplement quotes were verified verbatim in the transcript. Quote integrity remains excellent (24 quotes verified across both review passes, zero fabrications), anti-injection is clean, contradiction tiering is now consistently applied including the no-chase rule, and scope/DRY matches profile 6.1. Only trivial nits remain; content risk is low.
